article.story: BRYN MAWR, Pa. -- — Devin Royal had 22 points to lead Villanova to a 95-66 victory over Holy Cross on Friday night. Royal added seven rebounds for the Wildcats (1-1). Adam Oumiddoch hit three 3-pointers and scored 17, adding six rebounds. Luigi Suigo finished 8 of 9 from the floor to finish with 16 points. Tristen Wilson led the Crusaders (0-2) with 17 points. Chuck Hare totaled 10 points and nine rebounds. Villanova took the lead with 18:20 left in the first half and did not trail again. Suigo had 10 points in the first half to help the Wildcats take a 44-28 lead into halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
